sub_sector.value: freight railcar manufacturing; railcar rebodies and conversions; railcar parts

manufacturing_type.detail: Builds individual railcars on an assembly line, with welding and fabrication at its Mexico plant.

production_model.detail: Railcars tailored to each customer's needs; parts sold from stock inventory.

product_complexity.detail: Customized, purpose-built railcars in steel, aluminum and hybrid designs, with patented features.

production_role.detail: Designs and builds finished freight cars for railroads, lessors and shippers; also parts and service.

end_market_exposure.detail: Rail freight of bulk commodities and containerized freight; customers include lessors and railroads.
